melder.nexus.acl.configurations.profiles.label: full_access_profile
melder.nexus.acl.configurations.profiles.role: Factory module for the reusable full_access codegen ACL profile.
responsibilities: constructs the unconstrained top-end codegen profile variant
enables broad conduit, spell, and capability operations including recursive codegen
returns fresh FrameACLCodegenProfile instances through its strategy class

melder.nexus.acl.configurations.profiles.label: FullAccessCodegenProfileStrategy
melder.nexus.acl.configurations.profiles.role: The unconstrained top end of the codegen ACL model - above the standard ladder, not a rung of it.
responsibilities: enable imports without an allowlist and leave builtin/meta posture open
allow the broadest conduit, spell, and capability operations including recursive codegen
keep an open file posture by design: `open` available and imports unrestricted (0.2.8270)
